_about: Square Golf recipe. Starts the Square Golf Launcher, presses UPDATE when an update is offered (otherwise PLAY), signs in with the account Square remembers, skips the device search, and adds a Driving Range shortcut. Square Golf installs per Windows account under %LOCALAPPDATA%. Tested with Square Golf app 2.0.5.
title: Golf Simulator
subtitle: Choose a simulator to start

beforeEachSim._note: Square runs as two programs: the launcher window and the game itself.
beforeEachSim.label: Closing leftover sim apps

squareBoot._note: The launcher is an Electron app, so its buttons are pressed through UI Automation. UPDATE is pressed whenever it's enabled; then the step keeps waiting for PLAY (up to 15 minutes for a big download).
squareBoot.label: Updating if needed, then pressing Play

squareBoot._note: The game is a Unity app, so this is OCR. It only presses Sign in; it relies on Square's 'Remember me' and never types credentials. confirmGone re-clicks while the button is still there, because the screen shows it before it accepts input.
squareBoot.label: Signing in

squareBoot._note: Remove this step if you want Square to connect to the launch monitor over Bluetooth on its own.
squareBoot.label: Skipping device search

steps._note: The label under the tile on the home screen is clickable. No confirmGone here: the next screen's heading also says Driving Ranges.
steps.label: Opening Driving Ranges

steps._note: Starts whichever range and camera were used last.
steps.label: Loading the driving range
